<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

# Read input file
input_file = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
output_report = 'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv'
output_matrix = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv(input_file)

# Get indicator columns (exclude city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Calculate missingness per indicator
missing_counts = {}
missing_rates = {}

for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    total_count = len(df)
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_count if total_count > 0 else 0.0
    missing_counts[col] = missing_count
    missing_rates[col] = missing_rate

# Determine which indicators to keep (missing_rate <= 0.30)
kept_indicators = [col for col in indicator_cols if missing_rates[col] <= 0.30]

# Create missingness report
report_data = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    report_data.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': missing_counts[col],
        'missing_rate': missing_rates[col],
        'kept': 'yes' if col in kept_indicators else 'no'
    })

report_df = pd.DataFrame(report_data)
report_df.to_csv(output_report, index=False)

# Create selected matrix
selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + kept_indicators]
selected_df.to_csv(output_matrix, index=False)
</solution_file>
